Transcriber.call:
tr = transcriber.transcribe(input_path)
    text = tr.enhanced_transcript or tr.raw_transcript

options.name: enhanced_transcript
options.effect: Two-pass transcript enhancement; internally constructs TranscriptEnhancer (Finnish-tuned). For audio input, prefer this over adding a separate TranscriptEnhancer step.
options.infer_from: language == 'fi' (Finnish). For other languages enhancement needs prompt customisation; default off and flag to the user.

options.name: language
options.effect: ISO 639-1 language code (or 'auto').

options.name: diarization
options.effect: Speaker diarization (who spoke when).
options.infer_from: requirement mentions multiple speakers / meetings / interviews

options.name: additional_instructions
options.effect: Domain-specific correction instructions.

TranscriptEnhancer.note: Finnish-tuned. When the input is audio, do NOT add this as a separate step -- set Transcriber(enhanced_transcript=True) instead, which calls this internally. Use this standalone only to enhance an already-existing transcript (text input).

SchemaGenerator.call:
schema, requirements = _load_output_schema(schema_dir)
    if schema is None:
        schema = schema_gen.generate_schema(user_requirements=user_requirements)
        requirements = schema_gen.item_requirements
        schema_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _save_output_schema(schema_gen, schema, requirements, schema_dir)
SchemaGenerator.note: Use _load_output_schema() first -- the wizard pre-generates the schema; only call generate_schema() when _load_output_schema() returns None. Schema files are always named output_schema.* regardless of the class name.

Extractor.import: from gaik.software_components.extractor import SchemaGenerator, DataExtractor, get_openai_config
Extractor.construct:
config = get_openai_config(use_azure=use_azure)
    schema_gen = SchemaGenerator(config=config)
    extractor = DataExtractor(config=config)
Extractor.call:
schema, requirements = _load_output_schema(schema_dir)
    if schema is None:
        schema = schema_gen.generate_schema(user_requirements=user_requirements)
        requirements = schema_gen.item_requirements
        schema_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _save_output_schema(schema_gen, schema, requirements, schema_dir)
    extracted_fields = extractor.extract(extraction_model=schema, requirements=requirements, user_requirements=user_requirements, documents=[source_text])
Extractor.note: Use _load_output_schema() first. Schema files are always named output_schema.* regardless of blueprint schema_name.

PgVectorStore.call:
with store:
        store.setup()
        store.add(documents, embeddings)
        hits = store.search_hybrid(query_embedding, query_text, top_k=5)

options.name: hybrid_search
options.effect: Combine semantic + keyword search.
options.infer_from: queries mix exact terms (codes, names, IDs) with conceptual questions

options.name: re_rank
options.effect: Cross-encoder re-ranking of retrieved results.

options.name: top_k
options.effect: Number of chunks retrieved.

options.name: citations
options.effect: Include source citations in the answer.

options.name: stream
options.effect: Stream answer tokens.

LLMJudge.call:
report = judge.detect_hallucinations(source_text=source_text, extracted=extracted_fields)
    # report.flags: list of HallucinationFlag(.field, .value, .severity, .reason)

options.name: model_provider
options.effect: Judge LLM provider; using a provider different from the extractor reduces shared-model bias.

options.name: judges
options.effect: Two or more judges; diverse providers give the strongest debiasing via majority vote.
options.infer_from: high-stakes validation that warrants more than one judge

PostgresAgent.call:
with agent:
        ar = agent.ask(user_query)
    answer = ar.answer

options.name: table_allowlist
options.effect: Restrict which tables the agent may query (security).

options.name: answer_language
options.effect: Language of the natural-language answer.

options.name: match_mode
options.effect: Field comparison mode; 'semantic' needs a judge for free-text fields.
options.infer_from: free-text fields needing semantic (not exact) matching

options.name: skip_context_recall
options.effect: Skip the context-recall metric when no ground truth is available.

options.name: on_error
options.effect: Whether to skip dataset items that raise during the pipeline run.

FormUnderstander.returns: mapping of cryptic form-field ids -> human-readable labels

AudioToStructuredData.call:
result = pipeline.run(file_path=input_path, user_requirements=user_requirements, schema=schema, requirements=requirements)
    extracted_fields = result.extracted_fields
    source_text = result.transcription.enhanced_transcript or result.transcription.raw_transcript
AudioToStructuredData.note: End-to-end module: already transcribes (with Finnish enhancement), generates the schema, and extracts. Do NOT also add Transcriber / TranscriptEnhancer / SchemaGenerator / DataExtractor as separate steps.

DocumentsToStructuredData.call:
result = pipeline.run(file_path=input_path, user_requirements=user_requirements, parser_choice='vision_parser', schema=schema, requirements=requirements)
    extracted_fields = result.extracted_fields
    source_text = '\n\n'.join(result.parsed_documents)

options.name: parser_choice
options.effect: Which parser sub-component the module uses internally.
options.infer_from: input_formats: scanned/visual PDF -> vision_parser/docling_parser; text PDF -> pymupdf_parser; DOCX -> docx_parser

DocumentsToStructuredData.note: End-to-end module: parses then extracts. Do NOT also add a parser / SchemaGenerator / DataExtractor as separate steps; choose the internal parser via parser_choice.
